scope: Every numerical cell on the forecast-year rows of all labelled forecast tables in 11 linked XLS/XLSX files compared in regression tests with independently addressed original source cells. Includes separate gross/net/rooftop PV tables, TSP/adjusted sheets, large-load summaries and unlabelled numeric cells with original one-based column positions. Excludes Excel Compatibility Report. Forecasts are scenarios, not actual loads or point-in-time hourly forecasts. Forecast year bounds are source target years, not issue dates. Monthly/hourly/seasonal and forecast-performance workbook families are not covered by this reader.
